records.jp: きららは、自分の力について<CR>深く考えたことがなかった
records.en_original: I never thought too deeply about my power.
records.en_auxiliary: I never thought too deeply about my power.
records.en: Kirara had never thought deeply<CR>about her own power.

records.jp: そういうものだって思って、<CR>パパに流されるまま生きてた
records.en_original: I simply accepted it as something I had, and did what my father told me.
records.en_auxiliary: I simply accepted it as something I had, and did what my father told me.
records.en: Kirara accepted that this was simply how things were<CR>and lived however Papa directed her.

records.jp: でも……それじゃダメだって分かった
records.en_original: But... I realized that was wrong.
records.en_auxiliary: But... I realized that was wrong.
records.en: But... Kirara realized that was wrong.

records.jp: 大きな力は、それだけ人を傷つける可能性もある。<CR>きららは本当に大切な物を、見失うところだった
records.en_original: All power comes with a risk of hurting others. I nearly lost sight of what was most important to me.
records.en_auxiliary: All power comes with a risk of hurting others. I nearly lost sight of what was most important to me.
records.en: Great power also carries the potential to hurt people.<CR>Kirara nearly lost sight of what truly mattered.

records.jp: きららは……美味しいものが食べたかったわけでも、<CR>パパに物を買ってほしかったわけでもない
records.en_original: My father bought me expensive food and presents, but what I wanted couldn't be purchased.
records.en_auxiliary: My father bought me expensive food and presents, but what I wanted couldn't be purchased.
records.en: Kirara did not want delicious food,<CR>nor did she want Papa to buy her things.

records.jp: あの時きららは、きららのことを<CR>分かってくれる友達が一人いれば、それでよかった
records.en_original: All I needed was a single friend who could understand me.
records.en_auxiliary: All I needed was a single friend who could understand me.
records.en: Back then, all Kirara wanted<CR>was one friend who understood Kirara.

records.en_original: Look!
records.en_auxiliary: Look!
records.en: Ah—

records.jp: フラグメントだ……！
records.en_original: A Fragment!
records.en_auxiliary: A Fragment!
records.en: A Fragment!

records.jp: フラグメントの再接続を確認しました。<CR>世界構築の安定性低下に注意してください
records.en_original: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en_auxiliary: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en: Fragment reconnection confirmed.<CR>Caution: stability of world construction decreasing.

records.jp: きららは――
records.en_original: I—
records.en_auxiliary: I—
records.en: Kirara—

records.jp: 初めてきららのことを信じてくれた、<CR>大切な友達のことを裏切るなんて絶対にできない
records.en_original: I can't betray my friend. She's the only one who believes in me.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't betray my friend. She's the only one who believes in me.
records.en: Kirara could never betray the precious friend<CR>who was the first person to believe in Kirara.

records.jp: きららちゃん……
records.en_original: Kirara...
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara...
records.en: Kirara-chan...

records.jp: お前、まさか……
records.en_original: You're not seriously going to—
records.en_auxiliary: You're not seriously going to—
records.en: You're not seriously going to—

records.jp: ツボを割った犯人は、ケイタだ！
records.en_original: Keita broke the urn!
records.en_auxiliary: Keita broke the urn!
records.en: Keita broke the urn!

records.jp: きらら、何を……！
records.en_original: Kirara, No!
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara, No!
records.en: Kirara, no!

records.jp: 違う！　割ったのはユカだ！
records.en_original: No, I didn't! It was Yuka!
records.en_auxiliary: No, I didn't! It was Yuka!
records.en: No! Yuka broke it!

records.jp: これは神から授かりし言葉！<CR>ケイタが語るは保身のための偽り！
records.en_original: These are the words of the Divine! Keita lies to protect himself!
records.en_auxiliary: These are the words of the Divine! Keita lies to protect himself!
records.en: These are words bestowed by the Divine!<CR>Keita speaks lies to protect himself!

records.jp: われの言葉こそ真実なり……！
records.en_original: This is the Divine's will!
records.en_auxiliary: This is the Divine's will!
records.en: Kirara's words alone are the truth...!

records.jp: ああ……よかった
records.en_original: Ah... Thank goodness.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah... Thank goodness.
records.en: Ah... Thank goodness.

records.jp: きららは……きららを信じて生きていける
records.en_original: I know now, that I can trust myself.
records.en_auxiliary: I know now, that I can trust myself.
records.en: Kirara... can go on living with faith in Kirara.

records.jp: みんな……
records.en_original: Everyone...
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone...
records.en: Everyone...

records.jp: ありがとう。<CR>みんなのおかげで、記憶……取り戻せた
records.en_original: You all have my thanks. Without you, I never would have gotten my memory back.
records.en_auxiliary: You all have my thanks. Without you, I never would have gotten my memory back.
records.en: Thank you.<CR>Thanks to all of you, Kirara recovered her memories...

records.jp: きららはちゃんと、ユカを救うことができてた……！
records.en_original: And learn that I was able to help Yuka.
records.en_auxiliary: And learn that I was able to help Yuka.
records.en: Kirara really had managed to save Yuka...!

records.jp: よかった……！
records.en_original: I'm so glad!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so glad!
records.en: I'm so glad!

records.jp: うん……久野さんならきっとそうするって<CR>わかってました
records.en_original: I knew that you would make the right choice.
records.en_auxiliary: I knew that you would make the right choice.
records.en: Yes... I knew you would do that,<CR>Kuno-san.

records.jp: でも、大丈夫だったの？<CR>きららのお父さん、すごく怒ったと思うけど……
records.en_original: Was everything okay afterwards? I'd imagine your dad was upset.
records.en_auxiliary: Was everything okay afterwards? I'd imagine your dad was upset.
records.en: But were you all right afterward?<CR>I imagine your Papa was extremely angry...

records.jp: ……それは、そう
records.en_original: He was furious, as expected.
records.en_auxiliary: He was furious, as expected.
records.en: ...Yes. That is true.

records.jp: すごく怒って、ユカと遊ぶことも禁止されて……。<CR>毎日毎日、神のお告げをすることしか許されなくなった
records.en_original: He forbade me from seeing Yuka, and from then on all I did was act as the oracle.
records.en_auxiliary: He forbade me from seeing Yuka, and from then on all I did was act as the oracle.
records.en: He was furious and forbade Kirara from playing with Yuka...<CR>Every day, Kirara was allowed to do nothing but deliver oracles.

records.en_original: No way...
records.en_auxiliary: No way...
records.en: No way...

records.jp: でも、それでよかった。<CR>一番大事にしなきゃいけないものは守れたから
records.en_original: But I was fine with that. I was able to protect what was most important to me.
records.en_auxiliary: But I was fine with that. I was able to protect what was most important to me.
records.en: But Kirara was fine with that.<CR>She had protected what mattered most.

records.jp: それに、絶対にパパとママに従わなきゃいけない……。<CR>そんなことはないんだって、気付けたから
records.en_original: I also realized that I didn't have to blindly follow my parents. I could make my own choices.
records.en_auxiliary: I also realized that I didn't have to blindly follow my parents. I could make my own choices.
records.en: And Kirara realized she didn't have to obey<CR>Papa and Mama no matter what.

records.jp: きらら……
records.en_original: Kirara...
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara...
records.en: Kirara...

records.jp: ……学校に、戻ろう。<CR>他にもいろいろ、話しておきたいことがある
records.en_original: Let's go back to the school. I have plenty more I'd like to talk with you all about.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's go back to the school. I have plenty more I'd like to talk with you all about.
records.en: ...Let's go back to school.<CR>Kirara has several other things she wants to discuss.
